name: Makabe Kaori
source:
She is a new employee who just joined the company this year. She was unlucky enough to be chosen as a candidate for Sawatari's bitch-slave secretary.

She is not bad-looking, but she is a bit shy. She is not accustomed to society and is always timid even within the company.

She has a strong maternal instinct and is a bit of an “M” type.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/reizokuhisyo/index.html]official site[/url]]
